reports.text:
This one-time great trophy bass destination when it first opened in the 1990s appears headed back to that designation again, based on what anglers have been catching in the past few months since regulations were eased on bass and crappie. Two bass over 10 pounds were pulled out during the spring, one qualifying for the AGFC’s Legacy Lunker program before the March 31 cutoff. The survey produced bass in the 6-pound range, but AGFC Biologist Ryan Mozisek and crew continue to track and value reports from local anglers who have documented catches of 8 pounds and larger.
They say that more forage is more fuel for growth for the sport fish like bass and crappie.

reports.title: Lake Charles fishing report
reports.text:
Fishing suffered with the exception of crappie, as she received no reports on bream, bass or catfish.
Crappie, however, were biting fair around the shoreline on minnows and jigs. Rainfall totaled 3.3 inches over the past week, and the water temperature fell some as a result. Earlier this week it was 77.7 degrees, about a 5-degree drop from the same time last week. The “moon times” indicate that this weekend should be among the best times this month for anglers to get out on Lake Charles, she said. Good days are scattered throughout the middle of the month, and “best days” are back again in lake July.

Black bass are really locked in on the summer pattern.
He says some black bass are surfacing with whites and Kentucky bass.
Crappie are very slow. “You can find them in the vertical timber and brushpiles. They are just very finicky on the bite. Minnows or jigs, same bite.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Greers Ferry Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Crappie action is still great spider-rigging and vertical-fishing with minnows, small crankbaits and jigs. Black bass are schooling – some are shallow chasing bream, some are sitting and staying on structure out to 45 feet deep, and a gauntlet of baits are working.
For bass, a ¾-ounce spinnerbait and a red bug Ol’ Monster Zoom Worm will catch them.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Harris Brake Lake fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are good. Black bass are good; use a topwater in the early mornings, use a plastic worm the rest of the day.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Beaverfork fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are fair, use jigs in black/chartreuse, or minnows. Bass are good.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Charles fishing report
reports.text: Shelly Jeffrey at Lake Charles State Park (870-878-6595) said black bass are biting well on plastic worms (dark colors) and live worms, and also shad. The bass are biting around 5 feet depth. Crappie are good on minnows, jigs and worms.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Nimrod fishing report
reports.text: The crappie bite continues to be excellent. Black bass are good.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Norrell fishing report
reports.text: Bass have been good off of spinnerbaits, brooder minnows and assorted plastics. Crappie are fair off of No. 6 crappie minnows and pink crappie minnows.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Ouachita fishing report
reports.text: Todd Gadberry at Mountain Harbor Resort and Spa (870-867-2191/800-832-2276 out of state) reports that black bass are slow to fair. Crappie are slow.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Sequoyah fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are good on minnows, jigs and trolling little crankbaits in deeper water. Black bass are good; anglers are using topwaters early in the morning and small creature baits the rest of the day.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Winona fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are fair off of No. 6 crappie minnows as well off of No. 12 bass minnows. Bass have been good on crankbaits and minnows, too.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Millwood Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Also, Millwood Lake has received 611,275 Florida Bass fingerlings stocked this year per the AGFC.
* Largemouth bass: Over the past couple weeks, most largemouths are actively feeding at night and at early daybreak for a few hours in the oxbows of McGuire, Mud and Horseshoe lakes. Bill Lewis Lures’ SB-57 and Echo 1.75 crankbait square bills in Ghost Minnow, Bluegill and Sneaky Shad and MR-6 Crankbaits and Rat-L-Traps in Millwood Magic, SplatterBack or Ghost continue getting good responses as the sun rises and the largemouth transition to vertical structure after 9-10 a.m. With the lake on a slow fall, lots of the bass are pulling out of creek channels dumping into Little River and onto the…

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Saline River Access in Benton fishing report
reports.text: Lisa Spencer at Lisa’s Bait Shop (501-778-6944) said trotlines baited up with goldfish and black salties have been producing some great catfish as well as some bass. Crappie are good off of No. 6 crappie minnows and pink crappie minnows. Bass also are good on brooder minnows and black salties, along with plastic worms and 4-inch lizards.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Sunset Lake fishing report
reports.text: And crappie have been slow but are being caught deep off of No. 6 crappie minnows. Bass have been hitting on light-colored spinnerbaits, brooder minnows and No. 12 bass minnows.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Fayetteville fishing report
reports.text: Crappie aren’t being caught now. Black bass are good on topwater baits and plastic worms.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Hamilton fishing report
reports.text:
Bass have been doing pretty well lately! Largemouths are biting in the early morning and evening and even doing well at night. Shaded areas hold bass all day long. Spotted bass (God love ’em!) are hungry all the time and will eagerly take drop-shot rigs, Ned rigs and wacky rigs all day long on main points, piers and under boat docks.
Crappie are hit or miss lately.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Little Maumelle River fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are poor. Black bass are good early in the morning, then late in the day. The main river is better for bass fishing, he says.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Brewer Lake fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are fair. Black bass are in the shallows and the bite is good.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Craig D. Campbell Lake Conway Reservoir fishing report
reports.text: For crappie anglers, fishing deep will get good results. Use crappie minnows or small jigs. Black bass are good.
reports.lake: Craig D. Campbell Lake Conway Reservoir

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Overcup fishing report
reports.text:
Anglers are catching a few bream still, but crappie are slow and now in the deep water. He’s heard no reports on black bass or catfish.
Bass are doing well with crankbaits and buzzbaits. Crappie are being caught in 12-14 feet of water about 4-7 feet down.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Arkansas River fishing report
reports.text:
Fish ’N Stuff (501-834-5733) said black bass are slow, but you can catch them on some mornings using a buzzbait in white or black colors, as well as using a crankbait in shad or black colors, and with spinnerbaits around the jetties if you find some current. Also, a shaky head worm in June bug or red bug colors will have some success with the bass.
Black bass are biting early in the morning on topwater baits fished around the rocks. Crappie are in 8-10 feet depth off the riprap and will bite black/chartreuse jigs as well as minnows.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Beaver Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Crappie are on brush and also being caught on cranks. Bass are hit-and-miss with some early topwater happening.
Crappie are good. Minnows, jigs, trolling crankbaits and spider-rigging all are successful methods to catch the crappie. Black bass are good. Bass are going after jigs and a hodge-podge of other baits at night.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Bishop Park Ponds fishing report
reports.text: Bass are good off of bass minnows and black salties, as well as Zingtails and chatterbaits. Crappie are slow but the ones being caught are small in size off of size 6 crappie minnows and crappie jigs.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Brewer Lake fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are fair. Black bass are good.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Bull Shoals Lake fishing report
reports.text: For largemouth bass, fish with topwaters in the mornings. During the day, smallies and spotted bass (Kentucky bass) are stacked out on main and secondary points, sunken islands, humps, channel swing bluffs and bluff ends. Smallmouth bass are at gravel banks, boat ramps and old roads.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: DeGray Lake fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are holding close to the cover and the bite is slow. There are lots of bream in the cover with the crappie, so you get quite a few bites that are bream when you are crappie fishing. Drop-shotting for bream or crappie is a good way to get some action if you are weedless. But it’s bream, bass and crappie.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Greers Ferry Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Crappie are still eating well straight up and down on minnows and jigs trolled or small cranks. Black bass are on structure, schooling, and some still are up shallow eating a lot of different baits.
For bass, a ¾-ounce spinnerbait and a red bug O’l Monster Zoom Worm will catch them.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Harris Brake Lake fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are slow right now; there have been some fair catches. Black bass are good on plastic worms.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Beaverfork fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are slow, as cover is hard to find on the lake. Largemouth bass are fair around sundown and sunup; use spinnerbaits, topwater lures, chatterbaits, buzzbaits, and go to deeper areas.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Charles fishing report
reports.text: Anglers are catching a few bass on worms on the bottom; others are catching fair amounts using spinnerbaits, plastic worms and topwater baits. No reports on crappie or white bass.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Fayetteville fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are poor. Black bass continue to bite well; anglers are having success with topwater baits and plastic worms.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Hamilton fishing report
reports.text:
Bass have slowed down quite a bit in the last few weeks due to the water temperatures. Bass will be hanging out in deeper water and in shade, for sure. Bass can still be caught shallow on topwater baits like Whopper Ploppers, Horny Toads and Zara Spooks early in the morning and before nightfall.
Crappie have been sporadic.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Nimrod fishing report
reports.text: Crappie have turned around, with excellent results reported this week. Black bass remain good with the same baits as before: topwaters, worms, June bugs, War Eagle Buzzbaits in chartreuse, black and white colors all are working well.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Norrell fishing report
reports.text: Lisa Spencer at Lisa’s Bait Shop (501-778-6944) said crappie are doing well at night on No. 6 crappie minnows. Bass have been good on bass minnows and plastic worms.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Sequoyah fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are fair; use minnows, jigs or crankbaits. Black bass are good.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Winona fishing report
reports.text: 6 crappie minnows and Kalin’s Grubs. Bass have been hitting crankbaits and bass minnows.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Little Maumelle River fishing report
reports.text: Black bass were good and being caught in shallow water early in the mornings and late in the evenings.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Millwood Lake fishing report
reports.text:
* Largemouth bass: Have been in their typical summer habits and haunts for last few weeks. Cypress trees and knees near lily pads on shallow flats are drawing topwater blowups early, using black/blue or bleeding avocado buzzbaits, Bass Assassin Shads, soft plastic frogs and Stuttersteps in the oxbows.
Over the past couple weeks, most largemouths actively feed at night and at early daybreak for a few hours in the oxbows of McGuire, Mud and Horseshoe lakes. Bill Lewis Lures’ SB-57 and Echo 1.75 crankbait square-bills in Ghost Minnow, Bluegill and Sneaky Shad continue getting good responses as the sun rises and the bass transition to vertical structure after 9-10 a.m.
Bass Assassin Shads and…

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Saline River Access in Benton fishing report
reports.text: Lisa Spencer at Lisa’s Bait Shop (501-778-6944) said catfish and bass have both been doing great on black salties and goldfish. Crappie are being reported caught off of No. 6 crappie minnows in the deeper holes.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Sunset Lake fishing report
reports.text: Fresh chicken livers, bass minnows, nightcrawlers and stink baits have been doing well. Crappie have been slow, but they’re biting on No. 6 crappie minnows. Bass are fair on bass minnows and black salties.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Maumelle fishing report
reports.text: Westrock Landing (501-658-5598) on Highway 10 near Roland said water temperature remains in the mid-80s, and the l argemouth bass bite remains fair. The Kentucky bass (spotted bass) bite is also fair, with some reports of them being found in 18-20 feet off drops and rocky banks. Despite that fair bite, Cameron Nesterenko and Andrew Wooley still fished their way to a nice 16.30-pound stringer of five bass in Tuesday night’s tournament, and also caught the Big Bass of 4.96 pounds.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Peckerwood Lake fishing report
reports.text: Crappie remain poor. Black bass are fair; topwater baits and plastic worms are being used most.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Overcup fishing report
reports.text:
Crappie are good. Black bass are fair.
Bass are doing well with crankbaits and buzzbaits. Crappie are being caught in 12-14 feet of water about 4-7 feet down.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Arkansas River fishing report
reports.text:
Bass are being caught 2-3 feet from the jetties on shaky head worms, finesse jigs I watermelon red, square-billed crankbaits and Bandit 200s. In the backwaters, bass will bite buzzbaits and frogs. Crappie are good on Beaver Bottom baits off the jetties in the main channel of the river.
Black bass are biting early in the morning on topwater baits fished around the rocks. Crappie are in 8-10 feet depth off the riprap and will bite black/chartreuse jigs as well as minnows.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Beaver Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Crappie are being caught trolling various crankbaits. Bass fishing has been pretty good early and late, especially on cloudy days.
Crappie are good on minnows and jigs. Night fishing for crappie is really popular right now under the lights, they report. Black bass are fair. Also, follow the crappie anglers’ lead and cast for some bass under the lights.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Bishop Park Ponds fishing report
reports.text: Bass do well on black salties as well as on goldfish and also plastics fished wacky-rigged. Crappie are slow but are biting some on No, 6 crappie minnows and assorted crappie jigs, especially early in the morning.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Bull Shoals Lake fishing report
reports.text: For largemouth bass, fish with topwaters in the mornings. During the day, smallies and spotted bass (Kentucky bass) are stacked out on main and secondary points, sunken islands, humps, channel swing bluffs and bluff ends. Smallmouth bass will be around gravel banks, boat ramps and old roads.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: DeGray Lake fishing report
reports.text: Black bass are in their summer pattern. Lots of Kentucky bass on the move.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Greers Ferry Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Crappie are still eating well straight up and down on minnows and jigs trolled or small cranks. Black bass are on structure, schooling, and some are still up shallow eating a lot of different baits; just get it in front of them.
(updated 7-8-2020) Fish ’N Stuff (501-834-5733) in Sherwood says bass are biting well at the lower end of the lake in 15 feet of water on crankbaits, and in the early mornings on topwaters schooling.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Harris Brake Lake fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are good on minnows and jigs. The black bass bite is good on plastic worms and topwater lures.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Beaverfork fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are slow as cover is hard to find on the lake. Largemouth bass are fair.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Maumelle fishing report
reports.text: The largemouth bass bite has sloed. Kentucky bass are biting fair. In Tuesday night’s black bass tournament, Cameron Nesterenko and Andrew Wooley weighed in a five-bass stringer of 10.07 pounds, while Robert White and Mason hauled in the Big Bass of 2.87 pounds. Crappie are good.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Nimrod fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are good in 6 feet depth. Black bass are good, with topwaters, worms, June bugs, War Eagle Buzzbaits in chartreuse, black and white colors all working well.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Norrell fishing report
reports.text: Crappie have done fair on No. 6 crappie minnows, especially late in the evening. “One of my customers from out there said lots of them around there have been putting out more structure for the crappie. I know that out of the 35 years that I have been in business that this year has to have been the top year as far as catching good, big crappie,” Lisa says. Bass have been hitting minnows, black salties, plastics and spinnerbaits as well as buzzbaits.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Sequoyah fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are good on minnows, jigs and crankbaits. Black bass are good; throw a topwater bait in the early morning, and use a buzzbait late in the evening.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Winona fishing report
reports.text: Lisa Spencer at Lisa’s Bait Shop (501-778-6944) said crappie have been slow, but No. 6 crappie minnows have been catching some. Bass have been biting fair on minnows, spinnerbaits, Carolina and wacky-rigged worms.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Millwood Lake fishing report
reports.text:
* Largemouth bass: Early morning continues to be key for the best bite of the day. Good blowups are happening near stumps and cypress trees and knees on buzzbaits, Bass Assassin Shads, Spit’n Images and Stuttersteps, with the lake nearing normal water clarity and stain in the oxbows. Over the past couple weeks most largemouths continue active feeding at night and at early daybreak for a few hours in the oxbows of McGuire, Mud and Horseshoe Lakes.
Bass Assassin Shads and soft plastic frogs continue drawing random reactions at dawn from 5-8 feet of depth around stumps, lily pads and cypress knees. The Bass Assassin Shads continue working near lily pads at dawn and near cover, grass and…

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Norfork Lake fishing report
reports.text:
“ Largemouth bass fishing has also been good. If there is bait on the points, the bass will be from the surface down to about 25 feet.
Crappie are in the same area, but may move up into shallow water during the day.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Peckerwood Lake fishing report
reports.text: Crappie reports are poor. Black bass are good; use plastic worms or topwater baits.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Saline River Access in Benton fishing report
reports.text: Bass, smallmouth and largemouth as well as Kentucky bass, have been doing well off of black salties, minnows, Zingtails, and plastics in the colors of green pumpkin and watermelon red. Crappie have been fair on No. 6 crappie minnows and on Kalin’s Jigs, especially Tennessee Shad, up on deep pockets and anywhere you can find some brush.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Sunset Lake fishing report
reports.text: Crappie have been slow, but a few have been caught off of No. 6 crappie minnows, especially early in the morning or right at dark. Bass have hit on some topwater baits or plastic worms wacky-rigged.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Ouachita fishing report
reports.text: Todd Gadberry at Mountain Harbor Resort and Spa (870-867-2191/800-832-2276 out of state) reports that black bass are fair. Crappie are still fair.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: War Eagle Creek/Beaver Lake Area fishing report
reports.text:
Smallmouth bass fishing is happening in War Eagle Creek. Bass are schooled up in spring holes and when catching one, fish that spot a while longer and you may catch a half-dozen it the same pool.
In the Big Clifty arm of Beaver Lake, Rambo Cove access, North Clifty cove, the black bass fishing is excellent.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Craig D. Campbell Lake Conway Reservoir fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are good using minnows or jigs. Black bass are good.
reports.lake: Craig D. Campbell Lake Conway Reservoir

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Overcup fishing report
reports.text:
Crappie amounts have dropped down to fair, but there are still some pretty good-sized fish being caught, he said. They are in 13-15 feet of water with the crappie suspended at 6-8 feet. The best time for crappie is in the middle of the day. Black bass are good, with best success coming on purple jigs fished under the docks or plastic worms thrown in the grassy areas.
Bass are doing well with crankbaits and buzzbaits. Crappie are being caught in 12-14 feet of water about 4-7 feet down.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Arkansas River fishing report
reports.text:
Bass fishing has been tough, but they are biting well on black Bandit Crankbaits and green pumpkin and orange finesse jigs at the ends of jetties on the main channel.
Black bass fishing is slow. Crappie are good below the Terry Lock and Dam on black/chartreuse Super Jigs in 8-10 feet depth.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Beaver Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Trolling will be the most productive way to put crappie in the boat.
Bass are schooling early and late and dropping off into deeper water as day progresses.
Crappie are good. Anglers are trolling and night fishing under the lights for the crappie. Black bass are fair.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Bishop Park Ponds fishing report
reports.text: Bass have been fair on plastics and also some are being caught off small spinnerbaits. Some reports of small crappie being caught off of pink crappie minnows and Kalin’s Bleeding Tennessee Shad 2-inch Grubs.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Bull Shoals Lake fishing report
reports.text: During the middle of the day, you’ll find smallies and Kentucky bass on main and secondary points, sunken islands, humps, channel swing bluffs and bluff ends. For smallmouth bass, look to the gravel banks, boat ramps and old roads for good places to drag baits like a Ned rig, a Hula Grub, a tube, or a Lil’ McMinnow.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Crown Lake fishing report
reports.text: Crappie reports are poor these days. Bass are good; bring out your topwater baits in the early morning to catch them.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: DeGray Lake fishing report
reports.text: Bass are in their summer pattern. Crappie are slow for sure, in deep water brush or standing timber.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Greers Ferry Lake fishing report
reports.text:
“The overall catching is fixing to be super good all over as the water comes out of the bushes soon as it gets back to normal for a while, maybe,” Tommy said. “ Crappie are still eating well, with limits being caught most days; fish from 10-40 feet at present. Black bass are all over the charts from super shallow out to 40 feet.
(updated 7-8-2020) Fish ’N Stuff (501-834-5733) in Sherwood says bass are biting well at the lower end of the lake in 15 feet of water on crankbaits, and in the early mornings on topwaters schooling.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Harris Brake Lake fishing report
reports.text: Crappie improved over the past week, with good catches being hauled in. Crappie are being found in 10 feet depth and they’re biting minnows and jigs. Black bass are good; throw a plastic worm, a topwater bait and other usual bass lures.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Maumelle fishing report
reports.text: The largemouth bass remains fair. Kentucky bass also are fair. In Tuesday night’s black bass tournament, Robert Kinslow and Sam Drennon landed a 4.06-pound Big Bass, while Casey Tissue and Clayton Vote won the event with an 11.09-pound stringer of five bass. Crappie are good. There are reports of crappie being found in 14-16 feet depth.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Nimrod fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are excellent, too. The crappie are 6 feet deep and are biting minnows and jigs, specifically Beaver Bottoms. Black bass are biting well on chatterbaits, black salties, and June bug red worm and white/chartreuse colors.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Norrell fishing report
reports.text: Lisa Spencer at Lisa’s Bait Shop (501-778-6944) said crappie are fair on pink and No. 6 crappie minnows. Bass have been doing well off of black salties, plastic worms and spinnerbaits.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Winona fishing report
reports.text: Lisa Spencer at Lisa’s Bait Shop (501-778-6944) said Lake Winona crappie are fair off of No. 6 crappie minnows and blue/white crappie jigs. Bass have been going after the black salties.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Little Maumelle River fishing report
reports.text: Crappie aren’t showing much; poor results. Black bass are good, however, with bass being caught in shallow water early in the mornings and late in the evenings.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Millwood Lake fishing report
reports.text:
* Largemouth bass: Early morning continues to be key for the best bite of the day. Good blowups are happening near stumps and cypress trees and knees on Buzzbaits, Bass Assassin Shads, Spit’n Images and Stuttersteps early, with the lake nearing normal water clarity and stain in the oxbows. reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Norfork Lake fishing report
reports.text: Largemouth bass fishing has also been good. The areas that have been best for me have been the same places where I have been finding striped bass. If there is bait on the points the bass will be from the surface down to about 25 feet. They have been close to the shore all the way to the bottom, especially later in the day, but the times I am fishing they are out in the deep water suspended and feeding heavily on shad. There still has been some topwater action, but this activity is slowing down. Swimbaits, spinner baits and minnow shaped crank baits are all working.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Peckerwood Lake fishing report
reports.text: Crappie reports are poor still. Black bass fishing is good, with topwaters being the go-to these days.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Saline River Access in Benton fishing report
reports.text: Lisa Spencer at Lisa’s Bait Shop (501-778-6944) said some anglers have been catching some nice crappie off of crappie minnows. Bass have been doing well on black salties, a Zoom Zlinky in green pumpkin color, and also in the Brush Hogs. Trotlines baited up with black salties and goldfish have been bringing in some good catches of catfish and bass, too.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Sunset Lake fishing report
reports.text: Crappie have been biting early in the morning and later in the evenings fishing deep with both pink and regular crappie minnows. Some bass have been doing well off of minnows, Zing Tails, plastics and spinnerbaits.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Craig D. Campbell Lake Conway Reservoir fishing report
reports.text: Crappie continue to bite well this week. Black bass are good.
reports.lake: Craig D. Campbell Lake Conway Reservoir

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Arkansas River fishing report
reports.text:
Black bass are being found in the main river jetties that are parallel to the bank.
Black bass fishing is slow. Crappie are good below the Terry Lock and Dam on black/chartreuse Super Jigs in 8-10 feet depth.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Beaver Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Crappie are suspended at or near 15 feet and can be caught trolling cranks. Bass are in summer pattern and are fair at best.
Crappie are good trolling with deep-diving crankbaits or minnows, and anglers say they are starting to catch some under the lights. Black bass are good on topwaters in the mornings and spinnerbaits and plastics during the day and evenings.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Bishop Park Ponds fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are slow but are biting pink and size 6 crappie minnows. Bass have been good on minnows, plastics and beetle spins.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Bull Shoals Lake fishing report
reports.text: Whopper Poppers, buzzbaits and chatterbaits are the go-to baits for power fishing for smallies and Kentucky bass out on the main lake and secondary points, sunken islands, humps, channel swings, bluffs and bluff ends, where they are biting well on a swimbait near shad balls. For smallmouth, the gravel banks, boat ramps and old roads are good places to drag baits like the Ned rig, Hula Grubs, tubes and the Lil’ Minnow.

reports.title: Crown Lake fishing report
reports.text: No crappie reports came in. Black bass are good late in the evenings now in deep water.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Greers Ferry Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Crappie are eating well on minnows and jigs in pole timber, brushpiles or manmade structure in 10-25 feet, according to weather conditions. Some black bass are set up; the deep water temp has not gotten hot enough yet for all of them to be out.
Smallmouth bass are responding well to Carolina rigs and Whopper Ploppers at the lower end of the lake. Largemouth bass are prominent in the upper end of the lake, actively biting the Horny Toad in the early mornings.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Harris Brake Lake fishing report
reports.text: Crappie reports have been poor. Bass are good, with the most activity coming along the shoreline in the early evenings.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Charles fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are good with minnows, jigs and worms. Black bass are good using spinnerbaits, crankbaits, plastic worms, regular worms and topwater lures.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Maumelle fishing report
reports.text: Westrock Landing (501-658-5598) on Highway 10 near Roland said largemouth bass are fair. Tuesday night’s bass tournament indicates what can be caught: Cameron Nesterenko and Andrew Wooley brought in a winning 5-bass stringer of 12.57 pounds and the Big Bass of 3.35 pounds. Kentucky bass are fair. Crappie are good.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Nimrod fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are good, being found shallow over brushpiles. Black bass are shallow and the bite is good.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Norrell fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are fair on pink and No. 6 crappie minnows. Bass have been doing well on topwater baits and buzzbaits early in the mornings and late in the evenings.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Winona fishing report
reports.text: Bass have been hitting minnows, plastic worms and crankbaits. Crappie are good on crappie minnows and crappie jigs.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Millwood Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Millwood Lake received 55,000 of 300,000 Florida-strain bass fingerlings stocked recently by the AGFC. Current information indicates another 245,000 Florida bass fingerlings are yet to be added this year by AGFC hatchery personnel for a total of around 300,000 Florida-strain bass.
* Largemouth bass: Buzzbaits, frogs, Bass Assassin Shads and Stuttersteps are seeing improved reactions early, with the lake nearing normal pool and water clarity improving. Most largemouths continue active feeding at night and at early daybreak for a few hours, in the oxbows of McGuire, Mud and Horseshoe lakes.
Bass Assassin Shads and soft plastic frogs are getting good responses at dawn from 2-5 feet of depth…

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Norfork Lake fishing report
reports.text: He says bass and walleye fishing is also good. They both are suspended over the shoreline buckbrush. Topwater plugs and flukes are working, and dropping a nightcrawler over the brush will produce walleye. Also, bottom bouncers with nightcrawlers along the old shoreline will produce walleye.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Saline River Access in Benton fishing report
reports.text: Lisa Spencer at Lisa’s Bait Shop (501-778-6944) said bass have been doing well on minnows, black salties, No. Crappie fair on No. 6 crappie minnows.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Sunset Lake fishing report
reports.text: Bass have been hitting buzzbaits, spinnerbaits and bass minnows. A few crappie have been being caught early in the morning and late in the evening with pink crappie minnows and No. 6 crappie minnows.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Ouachita fishing report
reports.text: Todd Gadberry at Mountain Harbor Resort and Spa (870-867-2191/800-832-2276 out of state) reports that black bass are still fair. Crappie are fair.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Sequoyah fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are poor. Black bass are good using spinnerbaits and buzzbaits.

reports.title: War Eagle Creek/Beaver Lake Area fishing report
reports.text:
Loy Lewis with War Eagle Creek Outfitting (479-530-3262) said War Eagle Creek fishing is going great for smallmouth bass between the Arkansas Game and Fish Commission Public Access and War Eagle Mills area.

reports.title: Brewer Lake fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are being found at 10 feet depth over brushpiles, and the bite is good.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Horseshoe Lake fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are slowing down, and Ronnie says he’s been throwing back a lot of small crappie. Black bass are fair.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Fayetteville fishing report
reports.text: Black bass are also good on worms.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Hamilton fishing report
reports.text: Bass have been good up until this week on deep drop-offs of banks and bridge piers with fish holding and suspended at depths from 10-25 feet. Approaching these fish with drop-shot rigs, wacky weightless rigs and Ned rigs has produced well. With the water clarity becoming murky it is important to go to darker colors like plum, June bug and black for the simple reason that the bait is more visible. Topwaters like frogs and buzzbaits should also produce in and around debris-strewn areas. Bass will be touching hard cover, using it as a reference point to their position. Crappie should also be doing the same thing in brushpiles and bridge piers. Jigs in darker colors will be the ticket with…

reports.title: Arkansas River at Morrilton fishing report
reports.text:
The jetty tips have been good for bream and bass, he says, but where there is grass nearby the bass are moving toward the grass lines.
“Then you go up the Petit Jean River, and I had a man who caught some big crappie, not a lot, but some big crappie on live minnows,” he notes.

reports.title: Craig D. Campbell Lake Conway Reservoir fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are biting better, with good reports this week. Black bass are favoring spinnerbaits, plastic worms, topwater lures like frogs and buzzbaits, and chatterbaits.
